**Finding: compliant (no redline).**

The licence package in Article 5 meets the LICENSE fallback on its material terms, and largely the preferred position:

- **Affiliates/contractors** — Section 5.3 gives us an unrestricted right to sublicense through multiple tiers to "its Affiliates and other Persons" (no Harpoon consent; only a post-execution copy), reinforced by Sections 5.4 and 5.5 (Affiliate distribution/co-promotion in our sole discretion).
- **Successor transfer** — Section 13.4.1 permits assignment without consent to an Affiliate or a successor in a merger, stock sale or asset sale.
- **Not revocable at will** — Harpoon may terminate only for uncured material breach (Section 12.2.1, 90-day cure) or insolvency (Section 12.4); the at-will right in Section 12.3 is ours. On expiry of the Term the Section 5.1.3 grants become non-exclusive, fully-paid, royalty-free and irrevocable (Section 12.1.2).

Noted but not flagged: affiliate/contractor coverage sits in the sublicensing mechanic rather than the grant clause itself, and Harpoon retains an insolvency termination right alongside material breach.
